system.description:
Laying a warrior-healer's hand upon the suffering, you draw the pain from their wounds and grant a brief mercy.

This power functions exactly as the Obeah power of the same name. You must touch the subject, but as it works only on the willing it normally requires no challenge. Expending one Blood Trait lets the subject ignore all wound penalties for the next full turn; also expending a Willpower Trait extends the relief to the rest of the scene or an hour, whichever ends first. It has no effect on vampires. Valeren retests with Awareness.
